name: Internet / network issue
description: Checks local gateway configuration; does not prove Internet reachability.

rules.cause: No default gateway was reported on an IP-enabled adapter. Routed connectivity may be unavailable.

actions.label: Recommended next steps
actions.instructions: Check network cable or Wi-Fi, address assignment, subnet and gateway. Compare with a working workstation; a VPN or isolated network may intentionally omit a gateway.
